newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal readies airport firm for selloff '97.
newsitem.headline: Portugal readies airport firm for selloff '97.

text.p: The Portuguese government expects to complete preparations for the privatisation of airport company ANA-Aeroportos e Navegacao Aerea at the end of the first half of this year, Planning Minister Joao Cravinho said.
He said the government had not yet decided how to sell off ANA and added that the sale could take place late this year.
"ANA will be prepared at the end of the first half this year for its privatisation," Cravinho told reporters.
"The privatisation could be carried out in many ways, but the final model has not yet been chosen," he added.
He said ANA would be split into two companies: one would control the airport area and the other would operate air traffic control.
A Civil Aviation Institute will be formed to supervise the civil aviation industry, the minister added.
